candidates.title: Evening operations log
candidates.content: The service desk covers several products from one operations room. A wall display shows active incidents beside planned maintenance and informational notices. Contact details are stored in a separate directory, while the incident record contains the investigation notes and links to logs. New responders receive a short orientation on finding those links. A printed desk guide describes the telephone and paging equipment but does not assign individual investigations. During a review of the room layout, the team also documented how unfinished work must pass between people. The outgoing responder names a successor in the incident record. The successor replies that they have taken responsibility before the outgoing responder leaves. Open incidents remain on the board during that exchange.
